effect.fr: Tenu: Restaure 1/16 (6.25%) des PV max du porteur à la fin de chaque tour.
effect.en: Held: Restores 1/16 (6.25%) holder’s max HP at the end of each turn.

flavor.en: An item to be held by a Pokémon. The holder’s HP is slowly but steadily restored throughout every battle.
flavor.ko: 지니게 하면 포켓몬의 HP가 배틀을 하는 동안 조금씩 회복된다.
flavor.ja: 持たせると ポケモンの ＨＰが 戦闘の あいだ 少しずつ 回復する。
